app.title: Namma Check
app.tagline: A self-check for your own documents. Find where your name or date of birth differs before you apply.
app.positioning: This does not verify your identity, does not contact any government system and is not legal advice.
purpose.pan_aadhaar_link.desc: Check the fields that must match to link PAN and Aadhaar.
purpose.epf_claim.desc: Check the fields that often cause EPF claim rejections.
docs.count: {n} of 6 documents added. Add at least 2.
docs.max: You have added the maximum of 6 documents.
add.title: Add a document
photo.guidance: Crop to the name and date of birth only. You will see the exact image before it is sent.
photo.aadhaarGuidance: For Aadhaar: leave out the Aadhaar number, your photo and the QR code. Using a masked Aadhaar is safer.
photo.previewTitle: This exact image will be sent
photo.previewAlt: Cropped image that will be sent
photo.capOff: Photo reading is paused for today. Type the fields instead; checks work as normal.
photo.loadFailed: That file could not be opened as an image. Try a JPEG or PNG photo.
consent.title: Before you upload
consent.sent: What is sent: only the cropped strip you see, not the full photo.
consent.happens: What happens: the text is read, turned into name, date of birth, parent name and gender, and the image is discarded.
consent.never: What is never stored: your image, the text on it, or your details. The server keeps only anonymous counts (how many checks ran).
fields.confirmTitle: Check what we read. Fix anything that is wrong.
fields.typeTitle: Type the details exactly as printed on the document.
fields.name: Full name
fields.dobYearOnly: This document shows only the year of birth
fields.optional: Leave blank if the document does not show it.
fields.needOne: Fill in at least one field.
sample.notice: Fictional people. These are pre-filled examples marked SAMPLE; nothing is sent for reading.
report.noFindings: No differences found across these documents.
report.severity.blocking.desc: Strict systems will very likely reject this.
report.severity.risky.desc: Some systems reject this, some tolerate it.
report.field.name: Name
report.anchorHelp: Pick the document that shows your correct value. The fix plan will use it as the target.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.invalid_image.message: The image could not be read as a JPEG.
error.invalid_image.hint: Crop the photo again and resend it.
error.image_too_large.hint: Crop closer to the name and date of birth.
error.id_number_detected.message: The image seems to include an ID number. We discarded it without reading further.
error.id_number_detected.hint: Crop again so only the name, date of birth and gender are visible. Leave out the Aadhaar number, photo and QR code.
error.unreadable.message: We could not find a name, date of birth or gender in the image.
error.unreadable.hint: Retake the photo in good light, crop to the text, or type the fields instead.
error.daily_cap_reached.message: Photo reading is paused for today.
error.daily_cap_reached.hint: Type the fields from your document instead. Typed checks work as normal.
error.throttled.hint: Wait a few seconds and try again.
error.extractor_failed.hint: Try once more, or type the fields instead.
error.invalid_request.message: Some details could not be accepted.
error.invalid_request.hint: Check the fields and try again.
error.not_found.message: The service could not be found.
error.not_found.hint: Reload the page and try again.
error.internal_error.message: Something went wrong on our side.
error.network.hint: Check your connection and try again.
error.unexpected.message: The service sent an unexpected reply.
